+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chain_type", ["cause", "context"])
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_application_exception_chain_is_preserved(chain_type: str) -> None:
+    exception = LookupError("application exception")
+
+    async def error_app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise exception
+        except LookupError as exc:
+            if chain_type == "cause":
+                raise RuntimeError("endpoint error") from exc
+            raise RuntimeError("endpoint error")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "http.disconnect"}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    app = BaseHTTPMiddleware(error_app, dispatch=passthrough)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="endpoint error") as exc_info:
+        await app({"type": "http"}, receive, send)
+
+    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is exception
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_application_exception_suppressed_context_is_preserved() -> None:
+    exception = LookupError("application exception")
+
+    async def error_app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise exception
+        except LookupError:
+            raise RuntimeError("endpoint error") from None
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "http.disconnect"}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    app = BaseHTTPMiddleware(error_app, dispatch=passthrough)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="endpoint error") as exc_info:
+        await app({"type": "http"}, receive, send)
+
+    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is None
+    assert exc_info.value.__suppress_context__ is True
+
+
